question: What supreme principle of the syllable va is requested out of compassion?
premises: A request is made out of compassion.
The subject is the principle of the syllable va.
This principle is described as supreme.
inference: The speaker asks Īśāna to compassionately explain the supreme principle of the syllable va.
plain_english: Out of compassion, O Īśāna, tell the supreme principle of the syllable va.
